title: Online payments to check vanish from the Payments page when online buying is on but its database update is missing
what: The Online payments to check card lists money a gym paid online that did not become a plan. If online buying is switched on but the database update behind this list is not applied yet, the server answers 'not ready' and the page simply removes the card. A ready-made warning ('needs the database update') exists but is never shown here. HQ sees the Payments page as normal and never learns that paid-but-not-applied money may be waiting.
expected: When online buying is on but the list cannot be read, the card stays and says it needs the database update; it is hidden only when online buying is off.
how_often: whenever online buying is switched on before its database update
fix_line: Tell 'switched off' apart from 'not set up yet' and show the warning for the second

evidence: data:_sources/silent.csv rows for apps/hq/public: 5 catch rows flagged no/no/no; 4 of them call the error-note helper, so the script flag is a false negative
data:_sources/silent.csv holds this area's rows (5 silent catch, 18 fallback, 58 others)
